profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience in Embedded systems, Android Application Development, Current drain analysis and Performance analysis.
Interested in a challenging and innovative technical track career in embedded system or Android Application Development and Product Software Life Cycle.
B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering with distinction.
Skilled in requirement analysis, design, coding, reviewing, optimizing, unit testing, battery level analysis, performance analysis and maintenance of software modules.
Expert in embedded C, CMock, Unity, Android, Java, git, eclipse, sqlite3, ddms, ADT, hierarchyviewer, adb,battery-historian, systrace and battery analysis and performance analysis tools.
Recognized as a consistent performer, critical resource and a go-to person in the team.
Self motivated, ready to take up challenges, committed to work and a good team player

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
https://wearos.google.com/

* Led the design and development of core Wear OS system features, driving enhancements from concept through launch.
* Spearheaded performance and power optimization initiatives, identifying bottlenecks and implementing solutions to improve battery life and responsiveness.
* Drove the full lifecycle for power and performance features, from brainstorming and design to development and release.

positions.title: SDE
positions.description:
Worked on Designing, developing and maintaining libraries for embedded devices to enable them with IoT capabilities and to connect to AWS IoT Cloud services. 
Worked on integrating embedded device libraries on to FreeRTOS, a market leading embedded RTOS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Infotainment Systems
------------------------------
Worked as a senior software engineer in GM for the Android based Infotainment systems and RTOS based Vehicle Interface Processors(VIP)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Moto 360 Gen 2 (Android Wear Smartwatch)
 * Led battery optimization efforts, resolved critical drain issues, and developed automated monitoring tools.
 * Managed internal debug tools and used user data (BigQuery) to drive performance/feature updates with positive customer impact.
 * Served as the cross-team lead for battery performance enhancements.

Wearable Innovations (2017)
 * Developed and implemented a key differentiating feature (end-to-end) for a next-gen wearable.
 * Contributed multiple innovative concepts accepted into the product roadmap.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Moto 360 (Android Wear Smartwatch)
 * Served as a key liaison in the Software Product and Integration team, bridging software development and product management.
 * Analyzed system performance, identified bottlenecks, and prototyped solutions.
 * Led battery life analysis, benchmarking, and issue resolution; developed analysis tools and managed the product's power profile.
 * Acted as the point of contact for critical software fixes, build/integration issues, and user-reported battery problems.
 * Designed automated tests to simulate real-world usage for battery monitoring.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Android Phone Application (Motorola)
 * Led a team of 3, managing the core Phone application component across multiple product lines (incl. Droid Razr M/Max HD, Razr I, Atrix HD, Moto X/Ultra).
 * Owned and delivered key features like Fixed Dialing Number (FDN) and the VoLTE application component, ensuring timely, high-quality releases.
 * Executed rapid application upgrades for major OS updates (Jellybean) and new product launches (Moto X/Ultra) despite significant underlying changes.
 * Provided ongoing support, including feature development, bug fixing, code reviews, and managing carrier test acceptance.
 * Acted as the primary contact in India for the Phone Application, supporting stability testing and debugging efforts.

honors.title: Motorola Bravo
honors.description: Motorola Bravo was awarded for a doing faster upgrade path for Motorola Phone application and redesigning the code for faster future upgrades

honors.title: Motorola Bravo
honors.description: Motorola Bravo was awarded for fast bring up of music Android application on Motoactv initial prototype and delivering the code in high quality.
